JXPilot, a Java reimplementation of XPilot, a multiplayer gravity war game.
Copyright (C) 2026 Tony Kay and the JXPilot contributors.

Derived from XPilot 4.5.5, Copyright (C) 1991-2002 by Bjørn Stabell, Ken Ronny Schouten,
Bert Gijsbers and Dick Balaska. JXPilot is an independent derivative port: the original
XPilot authors were not involved in it and do not endorse it.

JXPilot is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or (at your option)
any later version; see META-INF/LICENSE. Source code: https://github.com/awkay/jxpilot
(each release's source is attached to its GitHub release as a tag archive).

Bundled third-party components:
  - Fira Code font (SIL Open Font License 1.1): fonts/FiraCode-LICENSE.txt (client jar)
  - LWJGL 3 and its native libraries: META-INF/licenses/lwjgl/ (client jar)
